bugs.name: Clearing product filters leaves invalid rank sort and empty list
bugs.summary: Clearing filters after searching for Carrot Juice clears the search but leaves sort=rank, producing an empty Products list and a persistent error that rank sorting requires a search filter.
bugs.expected: After Clear filters removes the search/filter state, the unfiltered seeded products should be shown without a sorting error.
bugs.actual: The search field and query parameter were cleared, but the URL remained /products/?sort=rank&asc=false. The list showed “No products found,” and an on-screen error said “Sorting by RANK is available only when using a search filter.” The failure remained visible after five seconds.
reproSteps: As the authorized dashboard admin account shown as admin@example.com, load the provided authenticated session; no credentials were entered.
Navigate to /products/. The initial Products page shows seeded products, including Carrot Juice.
Enter “Carrot Juice” in the Products search field and press Enter. The matching product appears at /products/?asc=false&sort=rank&query=Carrot%20Juice.
Open Filters, select the “Is available” condition, then click Clear filters without applying another condition.

Observe the terminal state at /products/?sort=rank&asc=false: the search field is empty, the list says “No products found,” and the visible error says “Sorting by RANK is available only when using a search filter.” The empty state and error remain visible after five seconds.

bugs.name: Add variant warns of unsaved changes after refreshing an unchanged product
bugs.summary: After saving and refreshing an unchanged product, scrolling to Variants alone marks details unsaved; Add variant then shows a leave-without-saving warning.
bugs.expected: After a successful save and refresh with the description and Material value persisted and Save disabled, clicking Add variant should open variant creation without an unsaved-changes warning.
bugs.actual: The refreshed product displayed the saved description and Material: Cotton with Save initially disabled. Scrolling to Variants without editing anything changed the footer to “Unsaved changes: details” and enabled Save. Clicking Add variant showed “Leave without saving changes?” and warned that unsaved product details, availability, and variant edits would be lost. Choosing Ignore changes opened the Create Variant page.
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and open Catalog > Products.
Create a fresh disposable product named mo-saleor-01-catalog-product-variant-warning-764281 using the existing Top product type.
On the product detail page, enter a description, set Material to Cotton, and save; verify the Product updated confirmation.
Refresh the product detail page and verify the description and Material: Cotton remain visible and Save is disabled.
Scroll to Variants and click Add variant. Observe that scrolling alone changes the page to “Unsaved changes: details” and opens the leave-without-saving warning.
Choose Ignore changes to verify the variant form opens; afterward, delete only the disposable product created for this reproduction.

bugs.name: Clicking existing Material option leaves required field invalid and blocks product save
bugs.summary: Clicking the existing Cotton choice leaves Material as uncommitted text, so the required field blocks saving product details and Channel-PLN availability.
bugs.expected: Selecting the existing Cotton option should set the required Material attribute and allow product details and the Channel-PLN availability change to save.
bugs.actual: After clicking the existing Cotton option, the field still displayed Cotton as text but showed “This field is required.” Clicking Save displayed the same error and “Some changes were not saved,” with Product details marked Failed; the channel edit remained unsaved.
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and open Products. Create a disposable product using the Top product type.
On the product detail page, enable Channel-PLN under Availability.
In Attributes > Material, search for Cotton and select the existing Cotton option.
Click Save. Observe that Cotton is displayed but Material says “This field is required” and the product details fail to save.

bugs.name: Exact-name product search omits a newly created product
bugs.summary: Exact-name search returns “No products found” for a newly created product that is visible in the unfiltered catalog; the result persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: Searching the Products list for the exact name of a product visible in the unfiltered catalog returns that product.
bugs.actual: The unfiltered catalog showed MOMENTIC-SEARCH-260926-K8N3, but searching for that exact name displayed “No products found.” The empty result remained after refreshing the search page.
reproSteps: Click Create Product, enter the fresh unique name MOMENTIC-SEARCH-260926-K8N3, select the existing Juice product type, and click Create. Verify the product detail page reports “Product created.”
Use the All products header control to return to the Products list. When prompted, choose Ignore changes. Refresh the list and verify MOMENTIC-SEARCH-260926-K8N3 is visible among the unfiltered rows.
Enter MOMENTIC-SEARCH-260926-K8N3 exactly in the Search products field and wait for the query to settle. The list displays “No products found.”
Refresh the search page at /products/?asc=false&sort=rank&query=MOMENTIC-SEARCH-260926-K8N3 and verify “No products found” remains visible.

bugs.name: Product setup still requires inventory when variant tracking is disabled
bugs.summary: The product setup checklist still marks Add inventory as required after the default variant is saved with Track Inventory unchecked, and says the product cannot be purchased until required steps are complete.
bugs.expected: After Track Inventory is disabled and saved, Add inventory should no longer be a required setup step for that untracked variant, so it does not block the product's availability setup.
bugs.actual: On the product details page, the checklist remained at 3 of 5 with Add inventory incomplete and an Add inventory button. It said customers cannot buy the product until required steps are done. Its helper copy itself said to turn off inventory tracking if stock is not managed. The variant editor still showed Track Inventory unchecked after reopening. Expanding Make available to buy stated the product stays a draft and customers cannot purchase until that step is done.
reproSteps: As an admin, use the authorized admin authentication state and navigate to /.
Open Catalog > Products and create a fresh product named QA-catalog-trackoff-7F3C9A with Default Type.
On the product, configure Channel-USD with a $10 selling price and choose Default Category so the channel, category, and price setup steps are complete.
Open the default variant editor, clear Track Inventory, and save the variant.
Return to the product details. Reopen the variant editor and verify Track Inventory remains unchecked; return to the product details and observe the setup checklist at /products/UHJvZHVjdDoxNjk%3D.
Observe Add inventory still marked incomplete and required, and expand Make available to buy to verify the product remains a draft and customers cannot purchase until that step is done.

bugs.name: Newly saved search-only product views are immediately labeled obsolete
bugs.summary: A product view saved with a search query and no filter conditions produces a migration warning for an old filter-preset version immediately after creation.
bugs.expected: Views created by the current Save view UI should be accepted as current and should not require migration.
bugs.actual: Creating QA Catalog View1009 from the Disposable1009 search, then reloading, shows 'You are using an old version of filter presets' and identifies that newly created view as needing updating to continue using filters. The query persists. A newly created view with a Product type condition saves and works without being flagged obsolete.
reproSteps: Open Catalog > Products and enter Disposable1009 in search.
Click the plus control to Save view, enter QA Catalog View1009 and Save, without adding filter conditions.
Reload the Products page with that view selected.
Observe the warning says the newly created preset is an old version and must be updated to continue using filters.
As a control, create a new view using the Product type filter; it persists without an obsolete-version warning for that view.

bugs.name: Image alt-text editor warns of unsaved changes after successful save
bugs.summary: Saving alt text on a newly created product image shows “Image updated,” but Back still opens a persistent “Leave without saving changes?” dialog; reopening confirms the alt text persisted.
bugs.expected: After the image editor confirms “Image updated,” Back should navigate away without warning that changes remain unsaved.
bugs.actual: After Save showed a green “Success — Image updated” notification, Back opened “Leave without saving changes?” and remained visible. After choosing Ignore changes and reopening the image editor, the entered alt text was still present.
reproSteps: Open / and use the supplied saved authenticated administrator session (loaded with AUTH_LOAD; no credentials entered or changed).
In Catalog > Products, create a new product named catalog-alt-3d2830dbf9 using the existing Default Type.
In the new product’s Media section, upload the unique image catalog-alt-3d2830dbf9-image.png and wait until its thumbnail appears.
Open the thumbnail’s pencil edit control. The image editor is at /products/UHJvZHVjdDoxNzI%3D/image/UHJvZHVjdE1lZGlhOjUw.
Enter “Unique test image showing an orange sun above a white mountain line on a blue background.” in Alt text, select Save, and wait for the “Success — Image updated” notification.
Select Back. Observe the “Leave without saving changes?” confirmation remain visible after settling.
Select Ignore changes to complete navigation, return to the same product’s Media section, and reopen the image editor. The alt text is present, confirming that it had been saved despite the warning.

bugs.name: Empty scheduled-publication date silently publishes products and collections immediately
bugs.summary: With Schedule for later checked, leaving or clearing the date saves successfully and converts the item to immediate publication.
bugs.expected: Require a valid future date when Schedule for later is checked, and keep the item unpublished until the date is valid.
bugs.actual: A previously scheduled product with its date cleared saved successfully, then reloaded as Live, Visible and purchasable with scheduling unchecked. Its visible Public API Test returned Purchasable,1variant. A collection changed from unpublished to Published with Schedule for later checked and a blank date likewise became immediately Published after Save/reload. Both paths were reproduced; product future scheduling was restored afterward.
reproSteps: Open a test product assigned to Channel-USD, e.g. QA Catalog Product1009 (product165), and expand the channel visibility controls.
Enable publication and check Schedule for later. Set a future date and save (control path).
Clear the Date input while Schedule for later remains checked, then Save.
Reload and expand Channel-USD: the product is now Live, Visible and purchasable, and Schedule for later is unchecked.
Click the visible Public API Test; it reports Purchasable with1variant.

Repeat on a test collection assigned to Channel-USD (QA catalog collection6): from unpublished, enable Published, check Schedule for later, leave Date empty, and Save. Reload shows immediate Published instead of requiring a date.
